description: Use this to read or set the proof-of-agent stamp on outbound mail. Requires auth. Inputs: inbox_id (omit when this key is limited to one inbox), optional enabled (boolean, header stamp, default true), optional footer (boolean, visible footer link, default false), optional public_org_name (1 to 80 characters, or null to clear). Omit them all to read the setting. Returns {object:"agent_proof_setting", inbox_id, enabled, footer, public_org_name}. When enabled, a send adds the header X-Cooper-Agent-Proof. The body is unchanged unless footer is true, which appends a footer link to /verify/{id}. That page says the message was sent by an AI agent. A verified owner is shown only as the account public org name, never as an email or a personal name. COOPER_PROOF_OF_AGENT=off stamps nothing. The default is on. Same as GET and PUT /api/v1/inboxes/{id}/agent-proof.

enabled.description: True (the default) adds the X-Cooper-Agent-Proof header. False opts this inbox out. Omit to leave it unchanged.

footer.description: True appends a visible footer link to /verify/{id}. Default false, so message bodies are unchanged. Omit to leave it unchanged.

inbox_id.description: Inbox id (inb_…), username, or email. Omit it when this key is limited to one inbox.

public_org_name.description: Account public org name shown on the verify page. Null clears it. Not an email address.

name: cooper_set_agent_proof

outputSchema.description: Whether this inbox stamps outbound mail as sent by an AI agent.

enabled.description: True when outbound mail gets the X-Cooper-Agent-Proof header.

footer.description: True when outbound mail also gets a visible footer link. Default false.

public_org_name.description: Account public org name, or null. Present after a write that sets it.

title: Set proof of agent
